grades.title: Grades
grades.subtitle: Performance report and ranking. 100-point scale.
grades.readOnlyNotice: Grades cannot be entered on this page. Only the subject teacher enters grades, in the Journal.
grades.chooseHint: In day view the columns are the lessons of that day. In week view the columns are subjects, and each cell shows the daily grades plus the subject average.
grades.topNHint: For example, 7 marks only the seven highest places. Leave empty to rank the whole class.
grades.dayHint: All grades for the day and the place within the class.
grades.weekHint: Monday to Saturday. Each subject cell shows the daily grades and the subject average.
grades.needClass: Select a class to see the report.
grades.noLessons: No timetable found for this class.
grades.noStudents: No active students in this class.
